{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
*1 whole [[Cookbook:chicken|chicken]], cut into pieces (breast cut into 4 pieces)
*3 large [[Cookbook:carrot|carrot]]s, cut into thirds and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] lengthwise
*1 large [[Cookbook:onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
*3 large [[Cookbook:potato|potato]]es, cut into 4 pieces each
*2 cloves [[Cookbook:garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*1 medium Roma [[Cookbook:tomato|tomato]], chopped
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] frozen [[Cookbook:peas|peas]]
*¼ cup [[Cookbook:oil|oil]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*[[Cookbook:pepper|Pepper]] to taste
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] ground [[Cookbook:cumin|cumin]]
*¼ cup dry white [[Cookbook:wine|wine]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] (1 [[Cookbook:Liter|liter]]) [[Cookbook:water|water]]
*2 chicken [[Cookbook:Bouillon Cube|boullion cubes]]
*1 yellow [[Cookbook:Chiles|chile pepper]] ([[Cookbook:Aji Amarillo|aji amarillo]]), seeded and thinly sliced lengthwise

==Procedure==
#In large [[Cookbook:Dutch Oven|Dutch oven]], heat the oil and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] onion and garlic. Once onion begins to soften, add chopped tomato and chicken pieces. Slightly brown the chicken pieces. Season with salt, pepper, and cumin.
#Once chicken has lightly browned, add the water, bouillon cubes and wine. Cover and allow chicken to [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] over medium-low heat for at least 30 minutes.
#Add the carrots, potatoes, and peas. Taste broth, as more cumin or salt and pepper may be needed.
#Add just enough water to simmer vegetables if needed. Once vegetables are done, remove from heat and allow to sit uncovered for 5 minutes.
#Serve with white, steamed rice.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Red [[Cookbook:jalapeño|jalapeño]] may be substituted for the yellow chile.
